The '''Norgk clan''' was a clan of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] native to [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. Their [[Norgk Clan Fortress|obliterated fortress]] was located near the [[Glonnk clan]]'s [[Glonnk Clan Fortress|fortress]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
